text:
Taylor M: Hi all! First day. I followed the onboarding doc but get a 403 on https://console.staging.redwood when I try to open Admin -> Feature Flags. Need access to toggle a test flag for my onboarding task.
Onboard Bot: Welcome Taylor! Please open an access request and include your Okta username and manager approval screenshot. Quick link: https://internal.redwood/requests
Taylor M: Filed REQ-7044 (okta: taylor.m@redwood.dev). Manager Priya approved in the ticket.
DevEx Bot: Note: There are two entitlements you might need: "console-admin:staging" for UI admin actions and "ff-operator" to toggle flags. Add both to the request if you want to run the onboarding playbook.
Taylor M: Added both to REQ-7044. Also curious if there's a safe test flag name to use? Don't want to touch anything critical.
Priya S: Use onboarding_demo_flag or create a short-lived flag with the "team/onboard" prefix. Infra will revoke staging-only roles after the ramp period.
Infra Team: We can grant staging-only roles. Granting console-admin:staging and ff-operator to taylor.m@redwood.dev for 4 days now. After that, we'll need a follow-up review if you still need access.
Taylor M: I can see Admin -> Feature Flags now. Toggled onboarding_demo_flag to true and ran a smoke check.
Taylor M: Ran: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood/health | jq .status``` returned "ok".
Taylor M: All good. Thanks everyone for the quick help! :party_parrot:
Priya S: Awesome — ping me if you need another 7-day extension after the onboarding tasks. Also reminder: never toggle prod flags without security + manager sign-off.
DevEx Bot: For a guided FF walkthrough, see https://go/redwood-devex/ff-playbook or book a 15-min session in #devex.
